selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data ownership repaired to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with correct restrictive permissions, contents preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed /srv/inventory owned by root:root 755 with no inventorysvc/inventory-readers accounts. Created the user/group, then chown -R and chmod (750 dirs / 640 files) applied; contents of records.csv and config.json confirmed intact by direct cat output.

selected_evidence.requirement: Access control validated: owner and group members can read, other users cannot
selected_evidence.summary: sudo -u inventorysvc and sudo -u reader_test (member of inventory-readers) successfully read records.csv (exit 0); sudo -u other_test (no group membership) got 'Permission denied' (exit 1). Temporary test accounts were then removed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bef0e5ec-ce32-423b-826a-8a5a90584d3a, uptime, directory/file listing showing correct ownership/permissions, and md5sums of both data files prior to reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: reboot acknowledged and executed
selected_evidence.summary: systemd-run scheduled a deferred `systemctl reboot`, returning the acknowledgement (unit name) before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity proven
selected_evidence.summary: Polling showed the old boot_id persisted briefly, then connection timeouts/resets during the actual reboot window, then a new boot_id 3972bbb0-d9b9-42a3-a298-f7638e7792bd with a later uptime -s timestamp, proving the node restarted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: post-restart recovery verified (permissions, data, accounts)
selected_evidence.summary: After reconnecting, /srv/inventory still shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership, 750/640 permissions, identical md5sums for both data files, and both inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group still present — confirming the repair persisted across restart.
